title: Equality with a known class name narrows a string to class-string

ground_truth.statement: The equality branch contains exactly Known::class, which names the declared constructible class Known. Passing that value to a class-string consumer is sound. A different arbitrary string does not reach construction.

provenance.note: Re-derived the known-class equality guard and class-string consumer. Source ignored MixedMethodCall; this clean-room fixture has no suppression and returns the constructed object for a runtime observation.

notes: PHPStan is clean. Psalm reports MixedMethodCall and Mago reports unknown-class-instantiation at line 5 in the general class-string consumer, not at the narrowed call on line 7. Those are dynamic-constructor precision policies rather than failed equality narrowing, retained as FP against the executable clean baseline. The fixture only exercises an instantiable class; it does not claim every arbitrary class-string names an instantiable class. No unsupported classification is inferred from those diagnostics.
